task.title: Harden festina-quick with verification, retry, and parity fixes
task.description: festina-quick has fallen behind other skills in quality patterns established during tasks 012-022. This task brings quick up to parity by adding a lightweight verification gate, directive compliance retry loop, research override option, skill-complete partial usage, missing doc command variants, and approach confirmation pause.
task.problem: festina-quick lacks quality gates that other skills already have: no verification of done criteria after implementation, one-shot directive compliance with no retry loop, auto-decided research with no user override, manual [FESTINA_COMPLETE] instead of skill-complete partial, missing doc list/check command variants (flagged in task 013), and no approach confirmation before implementation begins.
task.value: Reduces risk of incomplete or incorrect quick task implementations by adding lightweight quality gates that other skills already have, without sacrificing quick's speed advantage.
task.acceptance-criteria:
Given the quick skill source, when built, then it uses {{> skill-complete}} partial instead of inline [FESTINA_COMPLETE]
Given the quick skill context section, when rendered, then it includes show_list_product=true and show_list_engineering=true alongside existing search variants
Given a quick task completes implementation, when directive compliance runs and fails, then user can fix and the check re-runs (retry loop)
Given implementation is complete, when proceeding to finalization, then modified files are scanned for TODO/FIXME/HACK markers and user is warned if found
Given auto_decide_research determines "simple", when displaying the decision, then user is offered an override option to research anyway
Given determine_approach outputs the approach, when displayed to user, then user can confirm or adjust before implementation begins
Given a quick task with no directives loaded, when directive compliance runs, then it passes silently (no retry needed)
Given anti-pattern scan finds markers in files NOT modified by this task, then they are excluded from the warning
task.notes:
Integration points: - The skill-complete partial is at apps/festinalente/src/content/partials/skill-complete.md — single line output - The directive-compliance partial is shared across all skills — retry loop should be added to the partial itself or wrapped in quick's process - Anti-pattern scan pattern exists in festina-implement's verify_implementation_quality step — can be adapted as lightweight version - Task 013 explicitly flagged missing doc list/check variants for quick but only added success_criteria, not the partial flags - Content-build system compiles source from apps/festinalente/src/content/skills/festina-quick/SKILL.md
Design principles: - Keep quick lightweight — verification should be a quick scan, not interactive behavior-by-behavior testing - Approach confirmation should be a simple "proceed?" not a full spec review - Research override should be a single option, not a multi-step flow
